question: Which of the following is the size of the internal RAM in the 'Standard 8051' microcontroller?
solution:
The correct answer is option 1

__**Concept:**__

 
• 8051 is an 8-bit microcontroller built with 40 pins DIP (dual-in-line package).
 
• 8051 has internal RAM (128 Bytes) and ROM (4K Bytes)
 
• 8051 uses the same address but in different memories for code and data.
 
• Internal circuitry accesses the correct memory based on the nature of the operation in progress.
 
• It can add memory externally if needed.
